items.message: V2 REVIEWs when any sample also sees the 8 mm distractor inside the broad search radius (ambiguity margin). Spec expects AUTO on B.

recall-first contact envelope (half source thickness + weld-toe setback) reaches a web standing 4 mm proud of the skin, so V2 emits AUTO without SKIN_ERROR_BORDERLINE.  Accepted over-detection: the creation gate rejects the row, the recognizer stays recall-first.

the junction end edge sits a few mm from the long web face, so the recall pass splits it into two short supported runs and AUTO-welds the long web leg without MULTI_TARGET_CONTINUOUS.  Accepted over-detection: the creation gate owns the junction decision.
